institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

pitch-length-slower.title: Longer pitch text predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
pitch-length-slower.body: Pitches with a higher word count or greater overall length tend to fund more slowly for both male and female borrowers.

female-family-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their husband's role or family structure fund faster.
female-family-status-faster.body: Pitches from women that include details about their husband's occupation or general family structure tend to accelerate funding speed.

female-demographic-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific demographic details like child count fund more slowly.
female-demographic-detail-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify exact demographic figures, such as the number of children, tend to decelerate funding speed.

male-aspirational-future-faster.body: Male borrowers who explicitly mention dreaming of a better future may fund faster.

female-collateral-mention-faster.body: Mentioning a lack of collateral may accelerate funding speed for female borrowers.

female-templated-narrative-slower.body: Female borrowers who use standardized or templated narrative structures may fund more slowly.

female-environmental-detail-slower.body: Detailed descriptions of the borrower's environment or specific tools may slow funding for women.

female-specific-hardship-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe specific daily hardships, such as water access, may fund faster.

female-outcome-vs-input-specificity.body: For female borrowers, highlighting long-term outcomes like asset acquisition may accelerate funding, while specifying granular tool utility may slow it.

female-education-level-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their education level may fund faster.

female-exhaustive-listing-slower.body: Providing exhaustive lists of specific assets or family members may slow funding for women.

female-gratitude-slower-revisited.body: Female borrowers who include direct thank you notes to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-ed-tech-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify smartphones for school learning may fund more slowly.

male-direct-appeal-slower.title: Direct appeals for funding may slow funding speed for male borrowers.
male-direct-appeal-slower.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retired items.

female-local-currency-slower-revisited.title: Mentioning the loan amount in local currency may slow funding speed for female borrowers.
female-local-currency-slower-revisited.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retired items.

female-widowhood-drama-slower.title: Mentioning widowhood or employing dramatic narrative framing regarding personal struggle may slow funding for female borrowers.
female-widowhood-drama-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that widowed status predicts faster funding.

female-child-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide a specific count of children may fund faster.
female-child-count-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that child count was present in slower pitch.

female-family-challenges-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific family challenges or financial instability may fund more slowly.
female-family-challenges-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for income specificity puzzle.

female-income-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific monthly income may fund faster.
female-income-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new puzzle regarding exhaustive listing.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Pitches from women that include explicit expressions of gratitude to potential lenders tend to decelerate funding speed.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim regarding loan history.

previous-loan-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previously repaid loans predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
previous-loan-history-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim regarding demographic details.

female-income-specificity-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who specify precise income figures may fund faster.
female-income-specificity-puzzle.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new observations.

female-character-descriptors-faster.title: Female borrowers who use character-based descriptors like 'dedication' or 'resilience' may fund faster.
female-character-descriptors-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new observations.
